questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and make a grammatically correct sentence.**

Nowadays, many home buyers __________ interest in digital homes.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 4, i.e., are showing.**

The given sentence contains a __plural noun__ **'buyers**', which means the corresponding verb must also reflect this.

Also, the sentence uses the adverb 'nowadays', which means 'at the present time', eliminating the possibility of any past tense verbs.

So, only simple present tense or present continuous forms of the verb are appropriate here, viz, **show** or **are showing**.

Since the sentence implies that the act of showing interest is a continuous action that is taking place nowadays, 'are showing' is the best alternative for the blank.

questions.question:
Which two signs need to be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

6 ÷ 3 + 12 × 4 - 9 = 12
questions.solution:
Given equation: 6 ÷ 3 + 12 × 4 - 9 = 12

1) -, ×

After interchanging ‘-, x’, we get:

L.H.S = 6 ÷ 3 + 12 - 4 × 9

= 2 + 12 – 36

= 14 – 36

= - 22 ≠ R.H.S

2) ÷, ×

After interchanging ‘÷, ×’, we get:

L.H.S = 6 × 3 + 12 ÷ 4 - 9

= 18 + 3 – 9

= 21 – 9

= 12 = R.H.S

3) -, +

After interchanging ‘-, +’, we get:

L.H.S = 6 ÷ 3 - 12 × 4 + 9

= 2 – 48 + 9

= 11 – 48

= -37 ≠ R.H.S

4) +, ÷

After interchanging ‘+, ÷’, we get:

L.H.S = 6 + 3 ÷ 12 × 4 - 9

= 6 + 0.25 × 4 – 9

= 6 + 1 – 9

= 7 – 9

= -2 ≠ R.H.S

Hence, ‘÷, ×’ is the correct answer

questions.question: Five years ago, the ratio of the ages of A and B was 3 : 4. Five years from now, the ratio of their ages will be 4 : 5. What is the ratio of A and B, 10 years from now?

According to the question

(3x + 10)/(4x + 10) = 4/5

⇒ 5(3x + 10) = 4 (4x + 10)

⇒ 15x + 50 = 16x + 40

⇒ 16x – 15x = 50 – 40

⇒ x = 10

Present age of A = 3 × 10 + 5 = 35

Present age of B = 4 × 10 + 5 = 45

10 years after age of A will be 35 + 10 = 45

10 years after age of B will be 45 + 10 = 55

Required ratio = 45 : 55 = 9 : 11

questions.question: A wire, in the form of a circle, encloses an area 3118.5 cm². It is now bent to form a rectangle whose length and breadth are very nearly in the ratio 7 : 4. The length of the rectangle, in cm, is : (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

As we know,

Area of circle = πr²

πr² = 3118.5

⇒ 22/7 × r² = 3118.5

⇒ r² = 3118.5 × 7/22

⇒ r² = 141.75 × 7

⇒ r² = 20.25 × 7 × 7

⇒ r = √(4.5 × 4.5 × 7 × 7)

⇒ r = 4.5 × 7

⇒ r = 31.5

Circumference of circle = 2πr = 2 × 22/7 × 31.5 = 198

Circumference of the circle = Perimeter of rectangle

Ratio of length and breadth of the rectangle = 7x : 4x

Perimeter of rectangle = 2(l + b)

2(7x + 4x) = 198

⇒ 2 × 11x = 198

⇒ x = 198/22 = 9

Length of the rectangle = 7x = 7 × 9 = 63

questions.question: There are three positive numbers. If the average of any two of them is added to the third number, the sums obtained are 68, 74 and 98. What is the average of the smallest and the greatest given numbers?
questions.solution:
Let the three number be a, b and c

According to the question

⇒ [(a + b)/2] + c = 68

⇒ a + b + 2c = 136 ---(1)

⇒ [(b + c)/2] + a = 74

⇒ b + c + 2a = 148 ---(2)

⇒ [(a + c)/2] + b = 98

⇒ a + b + 2b = 196 ---(3)

Adding equation (1), equation (2) and equation (3)

⇒ 4( a + b + c) = 480

⇒ a + b + c = 120

First number = 148 – 120 = 28

Second number = 196 – 120 = 76

Third number = 136 – 120 = 16

Average of the smallest and the greatest number = (76 + 16)/2 = 92/2 = 46

questions.question: The value of 72 ÷ 6 of 12 + 4 × (5 – 3) of 2 ÷ 4 – 2 is:

Step - 1: Parts of an equation enclosed in 'Brackets' must be solved first, and following BODMAS rule in the bracket -

Step - 2: Any mathematical 'Of' or 'Exponent' must be solved next.

Step - 3: Next, the parts of the equation that contain 'Division' and 'Multiplication' are calculated.

Step - 4: Last but not the least, the parts of the equation that contain 'Addition' and 'Subtraction' should be calculated.

Given expression is

72 ÷ 6 of 12 + 4 × (5 – 3) of 2 ÷ 4 – 2

⇒ 72 ÷ (6 × 12) + 4 × 2 of 2 ÷ 4 – 2

⇒ 72 ÷ 72 + 4 × 4 ÷ 4 – 2

⇒ 1 + 4 × 1 – 2

⇒ 1 + 4 – 2

⇒ 3

questions.question: x is the 4th proportional to 12, 16 and 5; and 20, y, 15, 21 are in proportion. Then the value of (6x – y) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For **4th proportional** x: 12/16 = 5/x ⇒ x = (16 × 5) / 12 = 20/3.

For **proportion** y: 20/y = 15/21 ⇒ y = (20 × 21) / 15 = 28.

Value = 6x − y = 6(20/3) − 28 = 40 − 28 = 12.

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a3c3fb5f93e3efd2f2664a6f895d5eb89645b6abfd29b0c8ab97a07f548ef97.png] 

**Given:** x is 4th proportional to 12, 16, 5 and 20, y, 15, 21 are in proportion.

**Formula Used:** a : b :: c : d ⇒ a × d = b × c

⇒ 12/16 = 5/x

⇒ 3/4 = 5/x ⇒ x = 20/3

⇒ 20/y = 15/21

⇒ 20/y = 5/7 ⇒ y = (20 × 7) / 5 = 28

⇒ Required value = 6x − y

⇒ 6(20/3) − 28 = 2(20) − 28 = 40 − 28 = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fourth Proportional

If four quantities a, b, c, x are in proportion, then a/b = c/x or x = (b × c)/a.

Third Proportional

If a, b, c are in continued proportion such that a/b = b/c, then c = b²/a is the third proportional.

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is √(ab).</p

questions.question: Which act allowed the British government to suppress political activities and detain political prisoners without trial for 2 years?
questions.solution:
Option **1** is correct, i.e. __**Rowlatt act**__.

__
 
• The **Rowlatt Act**__ (**1919**) repressed political activities and allowed detention of political prisoners without trial for two years.
 
• It was legislation passed by the Imperial Legislative Council of British India.
 
• However, it received a lot of resentment from the Indian public.
 
• The non-official Indian members voted against the act.
 
• It led to the Non-cooperation movement. 

**Extra fact:**

 
• **​Vernacular Press Act:**

 
 
• The Vernacular Press Act was introduced by Lord Lytton (1876-1880).
 
• It was enacted to curtail the freedom of the Indian press.
 
• After this, the government kept regular track of the vernacular newspapers.

questions.question: The Minimum Support Price (MSP) protects farmers against which of the following?

options.text: Loss of crops due to unexplained diseases or insect infections
The high rate of interest by local currency lenders
Very dry, flood or any other natural disaster
An extreme drop in price during bumper production

questions.solution:
Option** 4** is correct, i.e. __**Extreme drop in price during bumper production**__**.**

__
 
• The **Minimum Support Price (MSP)** protects farmers against **an extreme drop in price during
 bumper production**__.

 
• MSP is the rate at which the government buys grain from farmers.
 
• Minimum Support Price is an important part of India’s agricultural price policy.
 
• It helps to incentivize the framers and thus ensures adequate food grains production in the country.
 
• Based on the recommendations of the Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP), the Department of Agriculture and Co-operation, Government of India, declares **Minimum Support Price** **(MSP)** for 22 crops before the sowing season.
